panel.title: Versions
panel.intro: Split a version into its own item, merge another item into this one, or choose the main version. Every change is recorded and can be undone for 30 days, newest first.
panel.makeMainPrompt: Clients that do not choose a version will start with this one.
panel.splitPrompt: This version becomes a separate item.
panel.splitPromptExclude: This version becomes a separate item, and scans will never group it here again.
panel.splitDone: The version is now a separate item.
panel.exclude: Keep it out of this item in future scans
panel.excludeHint: Recommended when the file was grouped here by mistake.
panel.mergeLabel: ID of the item to merge into this one
panel.mergeHint: Its versions, watch progress and access rules move here and the item is removed. Items with different external IDs, types or series are refused.
panel.mergePrompt: The other item will be removed after its versions move here.
panel.liftDone: Scans may group the file here again.
panel.hintFaststart: Recommended: remux with faststart (movie index at the start) so clients can begin without fetching the end of the file. Jelee never modifies the file.
panel.hintNoSeekIndex: This file has no seek index (Cues); clients may be unable to seek. Remuxing it, for example with mkvmerge, adds one. Jelee never modifies the file.

tracks.title: Audio and subtitle preferences
tracks.intro: Choose which original audio and subtitles a native Jelee client starts with. Nothing is converted, and you can still switch tracks in the client. Empty fields use your broader setting.
tracks.languageHint: A language code such as en, ja or zh-TW.
tracks.modeHint: Automatic shows them when the audio is in another language.

errors.identity: These items are different works: their external IDs or episode numbers disagree. Fix the metadata first.
errors.incompatible: These items cannot be combined: they differ in type, library or series, contain other items, or it is the only version.
errors.undo: This change can no longer be undone, or a later change must be undone first.
errors.busy: The item is being watched or processed. Try again later.

check.title: Direct delivery check
check.intro: Pick a client to see which versions it could receive exactly as they are stored, and why not. This is only an explanation: nothing is delivered, converted or changed.
check.listHint: Separate entries with commas or spaces, for example mp4, mkv.
check.invalid: Use up to 32 entries per list, each made of letters, digits, dots, hyphens or underscores, and a bit rate that is a plain number.
check.someDirect: At least one version can be delivered as it is.
check.noneDirect: No version can be delivered as it is to this client. Jelee never converts media.
check.reasonContainer: The container is not supported by this client.
check.reasonNotProbed: The file has not been analyzed yet, so it cannot be confirmed.
check.reasonVideo: The video codec is not supported by this client.
check.reasonAudio: None of the audio codecs is supported by this client.
check.reasonBitrate: The bit rate is above what this client can sustain.
check.layoutCuesFirst: seek index before the media data
check.layoutCuesLast: seek index after the media data
check.deliverySeparate: Delivered as the original separate file.
check.deliveryUnreadable: This client cannot read it; no conversion is offered.
check.deliveryUnprobed: Not analyzed yet; the file is still delivered as it is.
check.deliveryFailed: The file could not be analyzed; it is still delivered as it is.
